Built for those who build.

The best advisors know what it means to build. Stonework Risk serves entrepreneurs, business owners, and high-net-worth individuals whose risk profiles are as considered as their ambitions.

As an independent agency, our only allegiance is to the right solution. We access a broad market to find coverage built around your needs, and we advocate on your behalf when it matters most.

Who we serve

The clients we are built for

Auto dealers

Garage liability, dealer open lot and inventory, and the fleet and workers' comp exposures that come with running a lot.

Gaming & route operators

Property, liability and crime coverage for game rooms, route operators and amusement businesses — a class many standard markets decline.

Professional & financial firms

Cyber, management liability and umbrella programs for law firms, wealth advisors and consultancies.

Real estate & development

Property, liability and excess programs for owners, developers and investors holding real assets.

Technology companies

Cyber, D&O and employment practices coverage for software and venture-backed teams as they scale.

Private clients & families

High-value homes, collector vehicles, boats and personal umbrella coordinated as one household program.

Approach

How an engagement works

01

Exposure review

We start with how the business actually runs — operations, contracts, payroll, fleet, property — and find where the exposure really sits before anyone talks about premium.

02

Market access

As an independent agency we place through national carriers and wholesale markets, so the structure follows the risk instead of whatever one carrier happens to sell.

03

Ongoing advocacy

Renewals get worked ahead of the date rather than on it, and when a claim comes we handle the carrier side of it for you.

About

An operator's agency

Stonework Risk is an independent insurance agency in Dallas, run by operators. We have bought these policies as clients before placing them as brokers, and we read a schedule of coverage the way an owner does — looking for what happens on the worst day.

Independent means no quota and no house carrier. We are paid to place the right structure, which includes telling you when your current program is already the right one.

Founder & Principal

Kris Gardner

Kris founded Stonework Risk to bring an owner's perspective to the broker's side of the table. Alongside the agency, Kris builds and runs other operating companies, so the policies Stonework places are ones Kris has bought and renewed as a client.

Every client works with Kris directly, from the first exposure review through each renewal.
